result.description: A fictional 27-inch quantum-dot IPS monitor designed for color-critical simulation dashboards, interactive visualization walls, and multi-window productivity. The AuroraPanel 27Q features a 2560×1440 native resolution, 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response mode, USB-C display input with power delivery, and an adjustable stand for ergonomic studio setups. It is marketed as a silent, low-power display solution for control rooms and creative suites rather than gaming or workstation graphics hardware.
